blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon has criticized Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp for continuing to use what he described as disproven arguments in responding to the prosecution’s formal offer of evidence, saying the defense panel could best be described as “defenseless.” Ridon, a member of the House of Representatives’ prosecution panel, said in an ambush interview on Tuesday that he could not understand why the defense panel in the impeachment trial continued to rely on the same arguments, questioning the credibility of the documents and alleging a fishing expedition, despite these claims having been repeatedly refuted.
